author: Praxis III
title: Copula‑DAQB: Global rank‑Gaussian preconditioner + BRBG + DAQB (k=48)
abstract: We add a global per‑gene rank‑Gaussian (copula) transform after log1p on HVGs to stabilize heavy tails before PCA‑based batch residualization and DAQB (δ=0.10, kd=20, k=48). Embedding remains EtC (FWPCA→ComBat). Hypothesis: improved linearity aids BRBG+DAQB without over‑warping cross‑batch covariance.
